cohort: The study enrolled 438 postpartum females with a mean age of 31.23 years, 4-6 weeks after delivery.
finding: Both postnatal depression (PD) and postnatal anxiety (PA) partially mediated the correlation between psychological abuse and postpartum psychotic experiences (PPEs), fully mediated the association between neglect and PPEs, and greater child psychological abuse was directly and strongly correlated with higher PPEs.
